caption:
Mortgage rates dipped again. 🏠

Freddie Mac says the average 30-year rate fell to 7.18% this week, the third straight drop. It peaked at 7.40% in mid-October.

A year ago it was 6.22%.

Are you waiting on rates, or have you stopped looking?
